summary: Defines management objects (a MIB module, NHDP-MIB) for configuring parameters of the Neighborhood Discovery Protocol process on a router. It is a standards-track specification. It was replaced by RFC 7939.

eli5.summary: Routers that find their neighbors need a control panel. This memo defined the dials for it, and later got replaced by a newer panel.

questions: how to configure nhdp with snmp
